descriptions.text: Skyward Finance has come crashing down to earth. The NEAR-based token launchpad had its treasury drained of approximately $3.2M. Don't fly too NEAR to the sun.

According to Cointelegraph, Skyward Finance, the NEAR on-chain asset issuance platform, suffered a vulnerability exploit and has lost 110 NEAR tokens (about $3 million). The Ref Finance and Skyward teams have been informed of the existence of the vulnerability. The attackers reportedly purchased large amounts of Skyward Tokens on Ref Finance, then redeemed them through the Treasury on Skyward Finance, and then earned more than the value of the Skyward Tokens originally invested.

On November 2, 2022, Skyward Finance's treasury on NEAR was drained for approximately $3.2 million. An attacker exploited a flaw in the redemption function, allowing repeated claims against the same SKYWARD token balance and rapidly emptying the protocol's reserves. A logic flaw in the treasury redemption contract allowed repeated asset redemptions against the same SKYWARD token balance, as accounting checks did not decrement or burn tokens before payout.
